title: Generals without clearance turned away at Cape Canaveral gate
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: So we would have people like three star generals that are on vacation in Florida drive up

plain: Three-star generals on holiday in Florida would sometimes drive up to the gate at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station and be turned away because they lacked the clearance to get in, according to Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor who says he worked there in the 1990s. Rogers tells Michels this to show how tightly the site was guarded, on an episode where he says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar.
